cards.text: Psalm 86 is a prayer of David, Israel's king. He opens with no small talk at all: incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me. And right away, he tells God why.

cards.question: David asks the LORD to lean in and answer him. What reason does David give?

answers.text: He has served God for years

cards.text: Then David keeps going: preserve my soul, for I am godly. And then, no fine print: "You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You."

cards.question: As David asks the Lord to be merciful, he says he only calls to the Lord once in a while.

cards.text: All day long, friend, like a phone with the redial button STUCK. Then David prays, "Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul."

cards.question: David is asking the Lord for a LOT. What does David say the Lord is like?

cards.text: Then David says it plain: "Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy."

cards.question: David says he calls on the Lord in his day of distress because the Lord ___ him.

cards.text: Now David stops asking for a minute and starts bragging on God: "O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours." Nobody else even comes CLOSE.

cards.question: With none like the Lord, David looks ahead. What does David say all the nations God has made will do?
David says that the Lord alone is God.

cards.text: Then the prayer turns: David isn't asking for rescue now. He wants to LEARN, like the one coworker who actually reads the training manual.

cards.question: David asks the LORD to teach him His ___ so that he may walk in His truth.

cards.text: Next David asks, "Give me an undivided heart," a heart that's all in, not split down the middle. Split down the middle is me with the snooze button: half awake, half asleep, ALL the way late.

cards.question: David asks the LORD for an undivided heart. What does he want it for?

answers.text: So that he may fear God's name
So that he may rule with wisdom
So that he may forget his troubles

cards.text: Then David promises, "I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever." He asked for an undivided heart, and now he's praising with ALL of it.

cards.question: David says God's loving devotion to him is great. What does David say God has done for him?

answers.text: Delivered him from the depths of Sheol
Given him a long and peaceful life
Lifted him above every other king

cards.text: Then trouble walks in. Arrogant men rise against David, a band of ruthless men seeks his life, and they have no regard for God.

cards.question: Even with ruthless men after him, David says the Lord is slow to anger.

cards.text: Now David asks the Lord to turn to him and have mercy, to grant His strength to His servant, and to save the son of His maidservant. The same man who opened this prayer poor and needy is still asking for help.

cards.question: David asks the LORD for a sign of His goodness so that David's ___ may see it and be ashamed.
David ends the psalm saying the LORD has not helped him.
